company.name: Polarcus
company.shortDescription: Polarcus is an innovative marine geophysical company.
company.description:
Polarcus is a pioneer in the marine seismic exploration industry, responsibly expanding their operations without harm to their world. This practice is rooted in the Company’s core values of Responsibility, Innovation and Excellence. Their philosophy is communicated to their employees, customers, suppliers and stakeholders.

 
The Polarcus Management System describes the methodology by which they operate.
 
The Management System is based on OGP 510 encompassing the 4 basic fundamentals of Leadership, Managing Risk, Continual Improvement and Implementation together with 10 Elements in a Plan, Do, Check and Act process.  The Management System carries a hierarchic structure with Commitment and Accountability at the top, leading into the process flow encompassing their activities. 
 
The Polarcus organization is fully certified to ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001:2004 & OHSAS 18001:2007 while also subscribing to the prestigious DNV Triple-E program, an Environmental and Energy Efficiency rating scheme for ships.
